title: Production of chokeberry pulp powder by convective and freeze-drying foam-mat techniques: effects on physicochemical properties, bioactive content, and antioxidant activity
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1329-1340
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00150A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yasemin Yikilkan, Ali Ali Redha, Beyza Kaba, Hojjat Pasazadeh, Ilkay Koca
Chokeberry pulp powder, as a potential functional food ingredient, was produced by foam-mat drying via (a) convective drying at varying temperatures and (b) freeze drying; and the powder properties were examined.
